title: CIA-UAP-014, British activity in the Field of "Unidentified Flying Objects"
doc_notes: This is a CIA memorandum from December 1952 regarding British activities and committees investigating UFOs, which also references several other historical sightings.

incidents.summary: A 'perfect flying saucer' was observed by high RAF officials and pilots during a demonstration at a Yorkshire airfield.
incidents.quote: a "perfect flying saucer" was seen by these officials as well as RAF pilots

incidents.summary: Reference to a historical UFO sighting in Sweden.
incidents.quote: Jones reminded us of the Swedish incident

incidents.summary: Reference to the Tremonton, Utah UFO film incident.
incidents.quote: the film which had been taken by the Naval non-commissioned officer (Tremonton incident)
